input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Barnard tie tolerance computed as 1e-12*|T| became Infinity-Infinity=NaN when the observed unpooled statistic was infinite (e.g. 10/10 vs 0/10), dropping the observed table from its own region; caught by the reference comparison and fixed in engine and reference script.
First dense-grid reference ran out of memory on the 4,526-subject Berkeley table; rewritten to bucket by total successes and cap unconditional tests at 500x500.
A hand-typed reference value for log(200000!) in a unit test was wrong; replaced with Python's math.lgamma output.
The brute-force r x c reference first compared a log-probability without its constant against one with it (returned p = 1); fixed before any value was used.

doc_friction.issue: Useful: it caught an unguarded smooth scroll and an unrounded percentage that the venture's own tests could not see; each needed one preflight rerun (about 6 minutes each because of the build step).
The pkill hook refused `pkill -f '[r]eference.py'` because the same word appeared later in the command line; TaskStop on the background task was the working route.

notes: Explore idea: exact and stratified contingency-table tests as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/contingency-table-tests); no venture ran Fisher's exact, Barnard, Boschloo, CMH or McNemar. Verified vs scipy 1.18.1/statsmodels 0.15.0 (69 2x2, 8 strata sets, 5 paired), brute-force enumeration (16 r x c) and R's documented examples. Finding (eval/size.mjs, exact): at 20 per group Fisher's real size averages 1.9% (max 2.5%) at nominal 5%; Boschloo exact with 49% vs 41% power for 20% vs 50%; Pearson chi-square up to 6.5% at 25 per group. Discrepancy: scipy barnard_exact low in 22 of 272 p-values, all from exactly-tied mirror tables rounded 1 ulp below (checked with fractions). Local checks: 46 venture tests, meta-analysis tests, run_venture_tests, check_post_links, venture-preflight clean (build + check.mjs). No external outreach.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician implementing and cross-validating Fisher/Barnard/Boschloo/network r x c/CMH/McNemar with a page and size study

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
